startScreen.title: Foglight
startScreen.subtitle: The vale has gone dark. Light the three ancient Foglights and reach the Sanctuary before the mist finds you.
startScreen.howToPlay: WASD to move, Space to jump, mouse to look around the camera. Walk up to a Foglight and press F to light it. Avoid the Mist Guardian -- it will chase you if you get too close. Find the Vale Key to pass the sealed gate. Light all three Foglights to open the way to the Sanctuary.
startScreen.credits: Foglight -- an original Digital Opus Engine dogfood build. All models, textures, and audio created for this project.

ui.winMessage: You reached the Sanctuary. The mist recedes.
ui.loseMessage: The Guardian caught you. Try again.

objectiveDefs.title: Light the Three Foglights
objectiveDefs.description: Find and ignite all three ancient Foglights scattered through the vale.

objectiveDefs.title: Reach the Sanctuary
objectiveDefs.description: The fog has lifted. Cross the gate and step into the Sanctuary.
